entry.title: docs(http,api): document origin-keyed agent clusters by default
entry.content:
Closes #46194

Under WHATWG HTML PR whatwg/html#7617, agent clusters are specified to be origin-keyed by default.

This PR updates the documentation:

  1. \ iles/en-us/web/http/reference/headers/origin-agent-cluster/index.md:
    • Clarifies that modern browsers enable origin-keyed agent clusters by default (?1).
    • Documents \Origin-Agent-Cluster: ?0\ as the explicit opt-out mechanism to relax execution context back to site-keyed isolation.
    • Adds example for \Origin-Agent-Cluster: ?0.
  2. \ iles/en-us/web/api/document/domain/index.md:
    • Clarifies under failures that setting \document.domain\ is ignored by default in modern origin-keyed environments unless explicitly opted out via \Origin-Agent-Cluster: ?0.

cc @domenic for review as offered in #46194.

entry.title: Fix the list of conditions in the animation accessibility notes
entry.content:
Description

The accessibility notes on five animation-related pages share this sentence:

Additionally, certain kinds of motion can be a trigger for Vestibular disorders, epilepsy, and migraine and Scotopic sensitivity.

The list has "and" twice, so it's hard to tell where one item ends and the next begins, and "Vestibular" and "Scotopic" are capitalized mid-sentence even though they're common nouns. The five copies have also drifted apart slightly. This makes them all read:

Additionally, certain kinds of motion can be a trigger for vestibular disorders, epilepsy, migraine, and scotopic sensitivity.

Page Before
Web Animations API Vestibular disorders, epilepsy, and migraine, and Scotopic sensitivity
Using media queries for accessibility Vestibular disorders, epilepsy, and migraine and Scotopic sensitivity
animation vestibular disorders, epilepsy, and migraine and scotopic sensitivity
transition-timing-function Vestibular disorders, epilepsy, and migraine and Scotopic sensitivity
<animate> Vestibular disorders, epilepsy, and migraine and Scotopic sensitivity

On transition-timing-function, the same sentence also joins two independent clauses with "and" but no comma ("…(ADHD) and certain kinds of motion can be…"), so it first reads as if "ADHD and certain kinds of motion" were one list. I added the comma there.

Motivation

The serial comma and the comma before "and" between two independent clauses both follow the writing style guide. Elsewhere on MDN, "vestibular disorders" is lowercase, and #43983 already lowercased the terms on the animation page.

Additional details

The sentence on the four CSS and SVG pages has been there since the initial import. The Web Animations API copy came in with #43469, moved from an older version on the Animation page.

I checked that no other page has this sentence. #45603 also touches transition-timing-function, but it adds a section above the Accessibility heading and doesn't change this paragraph.

Related issues and pull requests

  • #43983
  • #43469

entry.title: [Technical review] Add BiDi `network.authRequired` and `network.continueWithAuth` pages
entry.content:
Description

  • Added a page for the network.continueWithAuth command of the network module.
  • Added a page for the network.authRequired event.
  • Added an "Authentication" section to the network module landing page.

Every example was run against Firefox Nightly 160 and Chrome 155 (through ChromeDriver) with a local server.

Spec links

  • https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#event-network-authRequired
  • https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-network-continueWithAuth

Related issue

Doc issue: mdn/mdn#851

Compat quirks worth looking into:

  • authRequired response in Firefox. BCD shows Firefox's response parameter as partial ("Basic support"), but in my test run it had every field, including status, headers and authChallenges, so the page's example comes from Firefox. Chrome's response was empty (status: -1, no headers, no authChallenges), which matches its partial entry. cc @whimboo for the compat sheet update.
  • continueWithAuth parameters. BCD has only a request parameter entry for continueWithAuth; action and credentials have none. cc @whimboo for the compat sheet update.
